problem.title: InTEn-LOAM KITTI 04: recursive fixed-rotation geometry consensus
problem.question: Does the frozen consensus/fixed-estimated-rotation mechanism improve complete recursive trajectories?

next_step: Review the uniform full-sequence experiment; repository extension stays default off.

variants.label: Fixed current reference
variants.intent: One new default-off Boolean s2s_geometry_consensus. Rule/parameters inherited unchanged from committed166 local factorial0e2ab939, which passes a necessary local gate. No new thresholds, per-sequence winner, GT/ROI input or retuning. Original profile07, diagnosis00, inherited DiLO01 prior0.03, and all past KITTI observations are development; no independent held-out claim.
